metadata.notes: Fixed seed 7; 90 minutes; empty or fully supported 45-cell declared production-learned grid; ERG sensitivity 3/5/10. Three identical 100W30s / 500W25s / 100W30s blocks at85rpm, separately scored. One native process per ride, paired identical earned starting fixtures. Includes 12s sensor outage and 60s actual cadence-zero rider pause outside probes. Training and testing both use seed 7; this is single-seed repeatability coverage; no physical hardware or flash-persistence validation. Whole-ride scores include the pedaling pause; requested power is unattainable at zero cadence. Display dates describe the batch execution. Original longride.json and unchanged full-rate case files are archived. Fully learned means the declared measured tested grid only; RAM fixture import does not test flash persistence.

limitations: Virtual packet/controller execution, no radio or ESP32 scheduler
RAM table import does not test flash save/load
Fully learned means measured support at all 45 declared training-grid cells, including brackets around 100/500 W, not the entire 300-cell firmware table
Window comparisons are descriptive; learning is not assumed to improve response
Same learned fixture for both firmware versions and all sensitivities; candidate-trained fixture provenance retained
Fitted effective plant, not independent hardware truth; positions/cadences outside recorded fit ranges are extrapolation
comparison.coverage_level: Continuous production packet/controller simulation with one native process per ride; no radio, ESP32 scheduler or physical hardware
comparison.budget_status: Provisional engineering bands, including early/middle/late probes and all three sprint blocks; not hardware fidelity proof

baseline.coverage_level: BLE-packet firmware ingestion + FTMS control + virtual motor; no radio or ESP32 scheduler
baseline.power_evaluation_signal: continuous effective plant output before sensor delay/noise
baseline.sensor_timing: independent acquisition, quantized forward to integration tick; immutable sample then delivery delay

plant_fit_support.meaning: Range check against original fitted ride only, not independent hardware validation. Outside-range plant behavior is extrapolated.

baseline.pause_model: 60-second zero-cadence rider cue with bounded deceleration/reacceleration; real FTMS pause/start packets are status-only in current production
baseline.event_count_meaning: Production log observations and insertion attempts, not guaranteed accepted insertions; gain logs are sampled, not exhaustive lookup counts.
